title: risk.json of a piece
description: The risk score of a piece after its executor round (<run>/<item>/risk.json, stages/review.py dynamic_review): the score of risk.score, the facts it was computed from, the threshold of review.dynamic_threshold and whether it added a review. The same record without item and run is state.items.<ref>.risk; readers outside orch take the file as published.

score.description: Sum of the weights of the features found, capped at 100.

features.description: Features found, each with its weight and evidence.

critical.description: Names of the features found that add a review whatever the sum.

added.description: The score or a critical feature added a review.

announced.description: REVIEW_ADDED was said (kept by a resume).

name.description: Feature name (public_cli, schema, security, shared, diff_size, red_first, deviation, outside_write_set, executor_recommended).

facts.description: Facts the score was computed from.

outside.description: Changed paths outside the write set.

red_first.description: An acceptance check was red in the first round.

deviation.description: The executor reported a deviation (or one was fixed automatically).
